_comment: IMPORTANT: When developing any MCP service, you MUST update all 4 template files: mcpWindowsTemplate.json, mcpLinuxTemplate.json, mcpUbuntoDesktopTemplate.json, mcpWSLTemplate.json

MCPUnifiedServer.description: Unified MCP Server: Independent MCP service with HTTP proxy to PyCore backend (59000). 20 tools total: File Processing (4), Database (7), Codebase (8), System (1). Includes OCR, document parsing, database operations, codebase analysis. Does not require pycore dependency to start.

ChromeMCPServer.description: Chrome MCP Server: Chrome extension-based MCP server that exposes Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants. Enables browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search using your daily Chrome browser. 20+ tools including screenshots, network monitoring, interactive operations, bookmark management, browsing history, and vector-based semantic search. Requires Chrome extension installation and mcp-chrome-bridge package.
